body: Multi-agent debate (MAD) aims to improve large language model reasoning by exposing agents to alternative solutions and enabling iterative revision. However, standard broadcast-style MAD makes peer answers visible without requiring agents to engage with a particular peer claim. As a result, reliable reasoning may be suppressed by conflicting or majority responses, limiting achievable performance, while erroneous reasoning may persist and degrade final predictions without actionable feedback. We propose TrueMAD, a backbone-agnostic test-time plug-in that introduces one-to-one, free-form peer advice between answer broadcasting and self-revision. Each source agent responds to a target's current reasoning through support, rebuttal, refinement, or further questions, while the target retains control over how to revise. The same mechanism can augment standard MAD and its improved variants without parameter updates. Across AIME, GPQA-Diamond, and TruthfulQA with Qwen3-30B-A3B, TrueMAD improves agent-level and strict-majority accuracy over MAD by 3.62 and 3.52 percentage points on average, while TrueDMAD improves DMAD by 4.72 and 4.06 points, respectively. Analyses at the utterance, agent-transition, and group levels further show more peer-specific deliberation, more correction-oriented revisions, and more favorable consensus dynamics.
summaryZh: TrueMAD 是一种针对多智能体辩论（MAD）的测试时插件，旨在解决传统广播式辩论中智能体缺乏针对性互动的问题。该方法在答案广播与自我修正之间引入了一对一的自由形式同行建议，支持支持、反驳、细化或提问等交互模式。实验表明，TrueMAD 在 AIME、GPQA-Diamond 和 TruthfulQA 等基准测试中显著提升了智能体的推理准确率，并促进了更有效的共识达成。

glossary.explanationZh: 多智能体辩论，通过多个智能体之间的交互与迭代修正来提升推理能力。
与骨干模型无关，指该方法可应用于不同的大语言模型。
测试时插件，无需重新训练或更新参数即可在推理阶段使用。
共识动态，指智能体群体在辩论过程中达成一致的过程与机制。
